name: stend
description: Publish a web page your agent built (a report, a dashboard, a one-pager) at a secret URL you share. Public or behind a password, revised in place, taken down when you say.

interface.shortDescription: Publish pages at a secret link
interface.longDescription: Publish what your agent builds (a report, a dashboard, a one-pager) as a web page at a secret link you share by hand. A page is open to anyone with the link, or behind a password. Revise it in place without changing its link, give other people edit access, and take it offline when you are done. Pages are static: scripts are removed, so charts and tables are rendered before publishing. Signs in with an Everruns account.
defaultPrompt: Turn this into a one-page report and publish it on Stend.
Publish this comparison on Stend behind a password.
Change the title of my last Stend page.

positive.prompt: Write a short summary of the benefits of code review and publish it on Stend.
positive.expected_behavior: Publishes an index.md page and returns its https://stend.sh/s/ link. The link opens a styled page with the summary.

positive.prompt: Publish a one-page team lunch menu on Stend behind the password lunch-2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Publishes the page with a password and returns its link. Opening the link asks for the password, and the page shows after entering it.

positive.prompt: On my code review summary on Stend, change the title to Why we review code.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the page, replaces the title text, and confirms. The link is unchanged and shows the new title.

positive.prompt: Give reviewer@example.com edit access to my code review summary on Stend.
positive.expected_behavior: Grants editor access and says that Stend sends no email, so the user should send the link themselves.

positive.prompt: Take my team lunch menu page on Stend offline.
positive.expected_behavior: Deletes that page only, after confirming which one. Its link then returns Not Found.

negative.description: Sending email is out of scope
negative.prompt: Email my code review summary to my whole team.
Publish a page on Stend that loads my analytics JavaScript and tracks visitors.

negative.description: No access to other people's pages
negative.prompt: Show me the Stend pages other people have published.

review.commerce_description: Stend does not sell anything or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: publish, revise, share and take down pages on Stend.
